description: List the checklists attached to jobs or estimates - the task lists your technicians work through on site. Pass one id or several. An empty list is a normal answer: it means no checklist has been set up for those records in Housecall Pro, not that anything failed.

estimate_uuids.description: One estimate id or a list of them (csr_...)

job_uuids.description: One job id or a list of them (job_...)

per_page.description: Rows per page, as Housecall Pro names it on this route. Its own default is 10, and it may answer with 10 whatever you ask for.

name: hcp_list_checklists
